# Treatment Schedules & Licenses

## Summary of dosing schedule and Defined Daily Doses (DDD) of CDK4/6 inhibitors

```{r}


tibble(
  Schedule = 
    c("Initial starting dose", "First dose reduction", "Second dose reduction", 
      "Days treatment within 28 day cycle", "WHO Defined Daily Dose"),
  Abemaciclib = 
    c("150mg Twice Daily", "100mg Twice Daily", "50mg Twice Daily", 
      "Continuous", "300mg (2 × 150mg)"),
  Palbociclib = 
    c("125mg Once Daily", "100mg Once Daily", "75mg Once Daily", 
      "21 days", "94mg (125mg × (21÷28))"),
  Ribociclib = 
    c("600mg Once Daily", "400mg Once Daily", "200mg Once Daily", 
      "21 days", "450mg (600mg × (21÷28))")
) |> flextable() |>
  set_caption("Summary of dosing schedule and Defined Daily Doses (DDD) of CDK4/6 inhibitors") |>
  flextable::footnote(i=c(1,4), j=c(4,1), 
      value=as_paragraph(
        c("Starting dose of ribociclib for adjuvant treatment is 400mg once daily, Ribociclib for adjuvant treatment was not approved during the data period of this study",
          "Daily frequency × individual dose × ( number of days per cycle ÷ cycle length)")),
      ref_symbols = c("a", "b"), 
      part = "body") |>
  width(width=4 , unit="cm")|>
  align(j=2:4, align="center", part = "all")


```

# Dispensing of Treatments

## Summary of number of tablets or capsules of different formulations issued by calendar year.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Get the dataset 
# Requires cleaned data
cdk46Data <- readRDS(here::here("data/cdk46_op_hosp_clean.RDS"))

cdk46Data|>
  mutate(year = year(year_month))|>
  rowwise()|>
  mutate(vtm = stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[1]) |>
  mutate(vmp_short_name = paste(stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[2:3], collapse=" ")) |>
  filter(year < 2025)|>
  group_by(vtm, vmp_short_name, vmp_code, year) |>
  summarise(quantity = sum(quantity)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = quantity) |>
  mutate(vmp = paste0(vmp_short_name, " (", vmp_code, ")"), .after = vtm) |>
  ungroup()|>
  select(-vmp_short_name, -vmp_code) |>
  as_grouped_data( groups = c("vtm"), columns = NULL) %>%
  flextable() |>
  set_caption("Summary of number of tablets or capsules of different formulations issued by calendar year.") |>
   flextable::footnote(i=c(6,8,10), j=c(2,2,2), 
      value=as_paragraph(
        c("Palbociclib capsules were phased out in January 2021")),
      ref_symbols = c("a"), 
      part = "body") |>
      colformat_double(digits = 0) |>
      font (fontname = "Arial Narrow", part="all") |>
      fontsize(size=10, part = "all")|>
      # dim_pretty(unit="cm")
      width(width=c(1, 5.5, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65) , unit="cm")|>
      add_header_row(values=c("Virtual Medicinal Product", "Calendar Year"), colwidths = c(2, 6))
      

  


```

## NHS Trusts and Cancer Alliances.

```{r}
cdk46Data |>
  filter(year_month < as.Date("2025-01-01"))|>
  group_by(`Cancer Alliance` = as.character(Alliance_name), `NHS Trust` = as.character(Trust_name)) |>
  summarise(`No of CDK4/6 tablets/capsules dispensed` = sum(quantity)) |>
  ungroup()|>
 as_grouped_data( groups = c("Cancer Alliance"), columns = NULL) |>
  flextable() |>
       colformat_double(digits = 0) |>
      font (fontname = "Arial Narrow", part="all") |>
      fontsize(size=10, part = "all")|>
      # dim_pretty(unit="cm")
      width(width=c(5,8, 3) , unit="cm") |>
    set_caption("List of NHS Trusts, by Cancer Alliance and total number of tablets or capsules of any CDK 4/6 inhibitor dispensed between 2019 and 2024.") 


```

# Dose Reductions

```{r dr-plot, fig.cap="Distribution of doses for palbocilib and abemaciclib dispensed in 2024"}

cdk46Data|>
  mutate(year = year(year_month))|>
  rowwise()|>
  mutate(vtm = stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[1]) |>
  mutate(strength = stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[2]) |>
  mutate(strength_mg = as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(strength, "mg") )) |>
  filter(vtm != "Ribociclib") |>
  filter(year == 2024) |>
  group_by(vtm, strength_mg) |>
  summarise(quantity = sum(quantity)) |>
  mutate(Dose_level = toOrdinal::toOrdinal(rank(-strength_mg))) |>
  mutate(percentage = 100*(quantity/sum(quantity))) -> doseSummary

doseSummary |>
  mutate(Dose_level = as.factor(Dose_level)) |>
  arrange(Dose_level) |>
  mutate(label = glue::glue(
    "{Dose_level} dose level:\n{strength_mg}mg\n\n{round(percentage,1)}%")) |>
  mutate(cum_percentage = cumsum(percentage) ) |>
  mutate(label_pos = cumsum(percentage) - (percentage/2)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=vtm, y=percentage, fill=forcats::fct_rev(Dose_level))) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggsci::scale_fill_jama() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") ,
        legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("Percentage of doses dispensed at this dose level") +
  xlab("CDK 4/6 Inhibitor") +
    coord_flip()+
  geom_text(aes(label=label, y= label_pos), size=3.5, color="white")
  
```

Dose modifications for CDK4/6 inhibitors are common. Ribociclib is supplied as 200mg tablets and therefore it is not possible to determine from aggregate issuing data how frequently a dose modification may occur. Different strength tablets are used to supply dose modifications for palbociclib and abemaciclib. Using the data from 2024, the proportion of different tablet strengths is shown in Figure \@ref(fig:dr-plot)

`r  format(round(sum(doseSummary$percentage[doseSummary$vtm == "Abemaciclib" & doseSummary$Dose_level != "1st"]),1))`% of patients on abemaciclib are on a reduced dose, in contrast to the MorachE trial which only had 43.7% dose reductions overall and just 13.9% on the lowest dose.

`r format(round(sum(doseSummary$percentage[doseSummary$vtm == "Palbociclib" & doseSummary$Dose_level != "1st"]),1))`% of patients on palbociclib were also dose reduced.
